Name: Death Note Valley (Early Access)
Author: Arimlaa
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]For those who find Stardew Valley's social dynamics too predictable and superficial, this mod introduces a new variable. I am integrating the analytical, pragmatic, and sugar-craving psyche of the world's greatest detective, L Lawliet, into the valley.

⚠️ EARLY ACCESS (v0.1.0) ⚠️
This mod is in its initial testing phase. The core architecture, daily schedules, and mandatory location dialogues are functional, but due to the unpredictable nature of game engines, you might encounter bugs. [u][b]Please treat this as a trial version and open a different save file[/b][/u]

ROADMAP & SUPPORT:
My ultimate vision is to create a complete 'Intelligence Expansion' featuring Light Yagami, Watari, and a custom technological headquarters. If you want to support the development of this strategic cat-and-mouse game within Stardew Valley, check out my Patreon page.

BUG REPORTING RULE:
Do NOT post bugs in the normal comments section. Submit all issues strictly via the "Bugs" tab and you MUST include your SMAPI log link. Reports without a log will be ignored.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Ensure you have installed all Required Mods listed below. 
2. Download the latest version of the .zip file. 
3. Extract (unzip) the file completely. 
4. Place the extracted folder directly into your "Stardew Valley/Mods" directory.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
- A fully integrated L Lawliet NPC with a functional daily schedule.
- Custom dialogues that are logic-based and pragmatic, in keeping with her analytical personality.
- Special Heart Events
- A meticulously designed, fully mapped Shared Room and house for the rental investigation.
- A special 4x4-sized outdoor Shared Terrace
- Unique festival interactions
- New pixel art
-SVE-compatible
[b]- Coming soon: Light Yagami, other characters, and more heart events[/b]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
- SMAPI (Stardew Modding API) 
- Content Patcher
